background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank AA- after its upgrade on 12 May 2026, S&P A+ and Moody's A1, all stable. The ratios are thinner than the ratings: CET1 of 12.6% is in the bottom quarter of UK majors, while leverage of 5.5% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 140% below the peer median and NSFR of 112% in the bottom quarter, and LCR has fallen 14 points since 30 Jun 2025 while the rest has been flat. The newest flagged item, on 10 Sep 2026, is repeated outages on the traders' risk platform, an operational warning set against strong trading profits that also show how market-driven the earnings are.
